author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮಾಡಿದವ ನಾನೆಲ್ಲವೆಂದು ನೀ ಬೀಗದಿರು
ಆಡಿಸುತಲಿಹಶಕ್ತಿ ಬೆನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿಹುದು
ಬಾಡೆ ಬಿಡದಿರೆ ಮನವ ಚೈತನ್ಯ ತುಂಬಿದವ
ಮಾಡಿಸುವ ಕೆಲಸಗಳ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Do not swell with pride that you did it all;
the power that makes you move stands behind you;
the one who filled you with life, who won’t let your mind wither,
is the one who has the work done, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Don’t take all the credit. A greater power moves us and keeps our spirit alive. We are instruments of the work, not its sole authors.
